blocks.text: Don't miss Julie Anne San Jose perform her latest releases on Live Jam!
MANILA, Philippines – Singer-songwriter and actress Julie Anne San Jose is returning to Rappler Live Jam on Thursday, October 1!
San Jose’s first foray into music was through the co-ed group SugarPop, which had released songs like “Ang Aking Mundo,” “Written In The Sand,” and “Mahal Kita,” among others.
In 2012, she made her solo debut with her self-titled album, which is fronted by hits such as “Let Me Be the One,” “I’ll Be There,” and “Bakit Ngayon,” to name a few.
This year, the multi-hyphenate star dropped two singles: “Kung Ikaw Ay Bibitaw” in March, and “Saglit Lang” in July.
Catch Julie Anne San Jose on Rappler Live Jam on Thursday, October 1, by bookmarking this page or heading to Rappler’s YouTube! – Rappler.com
